description: Research keywords, analyze competitors, check search rankings, and track your own site's search traffic and ad spend with cited, up-to-date data. Find keywords worth targeting, see why a competitor outranks you, audit a site for technical issues, and review your own Search Console, Analytics, and Google Ads for clicks, sources, positions, spend, and conversions after connecting those accounts. Useful for keyword discovery, competitor gap analysis, monitoring traffic over time, and seeing which campaigns are paying off.

defaultPrompt: Analyze my website and market. For my website, identify top competitors, keyword opportunities, traffic signals, and SEO gaps.
Research keywords and Google results for brewing chinese tea so I can write a blog post that has a strong chance to rank.
Map the landscape for lawyers in NY. Show who ranks, relevant keywords, and paid search opportunities.
